title: A double click selects a word and a triple click a line
body:
Drag selection (c813ecf) selects from the press to the pointer. Selecting one word or one line means dragging over it exactly.

## Proposal

A double click on transcript text selects the word under the pointer, and a triple click selects the line it belongs to, joined across soft wraps as a drag copy joins them. Each copies through OSC 52 as a drag does.
